title: Józef Chełmoński, Indian summer, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description One of Chełmoński’s most iconic paintings captures light, calm, and atmosphere with remarkable precision. The autumnal landscape — a woman watching a floating thread — invites stillness and quiet contemplation. This silver coin continues the series commemorating the painter’s artistic legacy. For collectors, it’s a conscious choice: of beauty, tradition, and inner peace. It’s also a tribute to transient moments that register in the memory like a delicate thread.
